name: @jetstreamapp/simple-excel
description: Streaming, dependency-free xlsx reader and writer for browsers and Node. Built for large files that must open cleanly in Excel, Google Sheets, LibreOffice and Numbers.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:declarations
scripts.build:esm: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/esm/index.mjs --minify --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --banner:js='/*! @jetstreamapp/simple-excel | MIT License | https://github.com/jetstreamapp/simple-excel */' && esbuild src/node/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/esm/node.mjs --minify --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --banner:js='/*! @jetstreamapp/simple-excel | MIT License | https://github.com/jetstreamapp/simple-excel */'
scripts.build:cjs: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/cjs/index.js --minify --format=cjs --platform=browser --target=es2022 --banner:js='/*! @jetstreamapp/simple-excel | MIT License | https://github.com/jetstreamapp/simple-excel */' && esbuild src/node/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/cjs/node.js --minify --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node20 --banner:js='/*! @jetstreamapp/simple-excel | MIT License | https://github.com/jetstreamapp/simple-excel */'

author: Austin Turner <austin@getjetstream.app>
